programme.desc: 'S18/E4 - Family Matters'. It's a family affair when father-and-son chefs Beto and Julian Rodarte compete to beat Bobby Flay! Model Jourdan Dunn helps decide who can take Bobby down.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S18/E5 - Baked To Perfection'. Pastry chefs Mathew Rice and Thiago Silva fire up the ovens. Ted Allen and master baker Gesine Prado decide who faces Bobby Flay in the kitchen.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S18/E6 - Drop The Mic'. Amanda Freitag and comedian Jo Koy invite chefs Ryan Hackney and Nora Haron to bring their kitchen skills and the winning punchline to beat Bobby Flay!

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S22/E6 - Timesaving Tips'. The team shares timesaving tips for simple meals packed with flavour. Jeff Mauro contributes his Cuban slider bake, and Geoffrey Zakarian prepares a roasted salmon.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S59/E10 - Legends: Alex Guarnaschelli'. Four chefs return as favourites of legendary judge Alex Guarnaschelli. A lowbrow but beloved item is in the entrée basket, specially selected by Alex.

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: 'S6/E5 - Christmas Roots'. Five crafty cookie makers design their version of a young Santa and Mrs. Claus and build cookie greenhouses with edible windows and herbs.

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: 'S6/E6 - Wacky Christmas'. Five merry cookie makers create edible Christmas comic strips and go big with cookie ornaments that incorporate some extra-small ingredients.

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: 'S6/E7 - Christmas Then And Now'. Five bakers create holiday cookies from when dinosaurs roamed the Earth and craft 3D vehicles fuelled with soda flavours for moving around the North Pole.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S36/E9 - West Coast Wonders'. Guy Fieri cruises California for some West Coast wonders. They include a charcuterie cornucopia in Healdsburg and a taste of New Orleans in San Diego.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S36/E10 - Smoker, Stove And Skewer'. Guy Fieri checks out all kinds of culinary, including mega sandwiches and a primo pot pie. A Mediterranean joint in Vegas serves awesome beef skewers.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S36/E11 - Interesting Italian'. Guy Fieri digs into all kinds of Italian. There's prime pizza in Santa Barbara, CA, and chicken parm strombolis in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S36/E12 - All-Over Flavor'. Guy Fieri's bathing in flavourful finds, including fried rice burritos in California, real deal Jamaican in Vegas and lobster meatballs in Florida.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S39/E1 - Smokin' Southern Decadence'. Guy Fieri samples smoking Southern meats at a family-run barbecue joint in Alabama. Then, he visits Chef G. Garvin's next-level steakhouse in Atlanta.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S39/E2 - French Flavor And Meaty Kabobs'. Guy Fieri dives into French fare and mouthwatering meat, including killer crepes in Colorado, elevated eats in Texas and kicked-up kabobs in Arizona.

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Summer Lake Adventure'. Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to cook up sweet and savoury breakfast treats and turn lakeside berries into mile-high summer pies.

programme.title: The Kitchen

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S8/E17 - El Paso'. Andrew Zimmern is in El Paso, Texas, to dive into its rich food culture. He tries everything from traditional fajitas and menudo to rolled tacos and entomatadas.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S8/E18 - Bay Area'. Andrew Zimmern explores the incredibly diverse food scene in California's East Bay area. He samples Chinese dim sum, Indian panipuri, American soul food and Mexican tacos.

programme.title: Aus Open Classics: 2008 (M) Final

programme.title: Aus Open Classics: 2024 (W) Rnd 2
